description: Create a single time entry on a subtask for the current user. Requires permission to log time.

date.description: Date of the work (ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-15).

hours.description: Number of hours worked (greater than 0 and at most 24).

start_time.description: Optional start time of day in 24-hour HH:mm (e.g. "12:00"). Set this when the user gives a specific time or a time range (and put the range length in 'hours'); the entry then runs from this time for 'hours'. Defaults to 09:00 when omitted.

subtask_id.description: Id of the subtask to log time against. All time entries are recorded at the subtask level.

text.description: Optional description of the work performed.

name: log_time
